1. import package ```js import { NFTStorage, File, Blob } from 'nft.storage' const API_KEY = process.env.NFT_STORAGE_API_KEY const client = new NFTStorage({ token: API_KEY }) ``` 2. ```js function dataURItoBlob(dataURI) { // convert base64 to raw binary data held in a string // doesn't handle URLEncoded DataURIs - see SO answer #6850276 for code that does this var byteString = atob(dataURI.split(',')[1]); // separate out the mime component var mimeString = dataURI.split(',')[0].split(':')[1].split(';')[0] // write the bytes of the string to an ArrayBuffer var ab = new ArrayBuffer(byteString.length); // create a view into the buffer var ia = new Uint8Array(ab); // set the bytes of the buffer to the correct values for (var i = 0; i < byteString.length; i++) { ia[i] = byteString.charCodeAt(i); } // write the ArrayBuffer to a blob, and you're done var blob = new Blob([ab], {type: mimeString}); return blob; } ``` 3. ```js ... const [dataUri, setDataUri] = useState("") const [ipfs, setIpfs] = useState("") const onChange = (file) => { if (!file) { setDataUri(''); return; } fileToDataUri(file) .then(dataUri => { setDataUri(dataUri) }) } const handle_mint = () => { const upload_ipfs = async() => { const img_blob = await dataURItoBlob(dataUri) //const img_cid = await client.storeBlob(img_blob) const metadata = await client.store({ name: 'My sweet NFT', description: 'Just try to funge it.
